company.name: MadeThis
company.shortDescription: MadeThis provides an AI co-founder platform that builds, launches, and operates online businesses using autonomous agent teams.
company.description: MadeThis provides an AI-powered co-founder platform for building, launching, and operating online businesses. The software lets users describe a business in natural language and then generates the underlying infrastructure, including custom websites or web apps, payment processing, email automation, and analytics. An autonomous team of AI agents handles coding, deployment, marketing and ad campaign management, customer support, and daily operations across e-commerce, courses, SaaS, agencies, and other online models. Users review and approve actions from a central dashboard or enable more autonomous operation within defined guardrails. MadeThis is offered as a subscription service with tiered plans that differ by task limits, number of businesses, domain options, and support level.
